intuition.title: Proposed ligand exchange and cluster dissolution
intuition.summary: The authors discuss ligand rearrangement, carboxylate-promoted dissolution and competing productive and nonproductive channels. These mechanisms and the Scheme 1 stoichiometric relation are interpretations. Cited earlier cluster structures and theoretical calculations remain attributed context; no new elementary-reaction product counts, DFT model or molecular coordinates are inferred.
intuition.scope: Source discussion; interpretation and cited context are distinguished in the text.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
